Split-screen shots compare his focused work state with his relaxed state in the chair. The camera uses medium close-ups to capture his facial expressions and the mechanical motion of the chair's headrest. Variety-style captions in Traditional Chinese float on screen. (5) The man returns to an upright seated position in the chair, speaking directly to the viewers with engaging hand gestures. A large final text overlay appears with a call-to-action link and promotional text for an appointment service, set against the same living room background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a rapid, narrative pace. An upbeat, electronic-pop BGM with a clear 4/4 beat starts simultaneously. A digital 'ding' SFX sounds as the timer hits a milestone. The mix is clean with the vocal clearly leading. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift in topic to the massage chair. The vocal pitch becomes more varied, using rising intonations to emphasize the product's benefits. The BGM maintains its tempo and energy, providing a constant rhythmic bed under the continuous narration. (3) Several short 'blip' or UI-style sound effects are layered over the speech as tech features are described. The acoustics are professional with no background noise. The interplay between the enthusiastic voice and the synthetic musical textures creates a modern, commercial feel. (4) The speaker's tone softens slightly during descriptions of relaxation, though the speech rate remains high. A synthetic bubble-pop SFX is heard. The BGM tonality is consistently bright and positive. No incidental noises from the chair are audible, indicating a separate voiceover recording. (5) The vocal intensity swells during the final call to action, accompanied by a concluding digital chime SFX. The BGM fades out quickly after the final sentence is spoken. The overall spectral balance is bright with high clarity in the mid-to-high frequency range for both voice and music.
